import math

p, q, r = map(int, input().split())

def get_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

if q <= r:
    g = get_gcd(p, q)
    p //= g
    q //= g
    print(f"{p}/{q}")
elif p == q:
    print("1/1")
else:
    best_diff = 1e18
    ratio = p / q
    numerator = 0
    denominator = 1
    left_bound = 0
    right_bound = q
    for i in range(1, r + 1):
        while i * p > right_bound:
            left_bound += q
            right_bound += q
        if left_bound <= i * p <= right_bound:
            low = left_bound // q
            high = right_bound // q
            low_ratio = low / i
            high_ratio = high / i
            diff_low = abs(ratio - low_ratio)
            diff_high = abs(ratio - high_ratio)
            if diff_high < diff_low:
                if diff_high < best_diff:
                    best_diff = diff_high
                    numerator = high
                    denominator = i
            else:
                if diff_low < best_diff:
                    best_diff = diff_low
                    numerator = low
                    denominator = i
    g = get_gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator //= g
    denominator //= g
    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
